name: Elite: lowdata
summary: The low data: the scanner and dashboard save areas, the font, the ship slots and the ship blueprints.

labels.name: ScannerSave
labels.comment: The scanner's background: 48 pixel lines of 13 bytes, $5049-$5055 on of the screen's bottom third
from here the bytes are TZX block 37's copy of the mastering machine's system variables (03-build-and-load.md 3.10)

labels.name: Font
labels.comment: The character set: 91 glyphs of 8 bytes for the codes $20-$7A, read by PrintChar $D499

labels.name: ShipSlots
labels.comment: The 8 ship slots, 39 bytes each: the objects in space

labels.name: Slot7
labels.comment: Slot 7, the last of the eight: the player's missile in flight, the turning ship on the title. The code names it directly (TurnTitleShip, ActionTitleShip, the hostility test of UpdateSlot); it is no work copy: the ship routines work on each slot in place

labels.name: Blueprints
labels.comment: The blueprint table: 19 entries of $C3, the blueprint address and its class
